checks: Opening the app does not create a report or inquiry
Walkthrough is accessible from the app
Loading the example saves contacts, not an incident or calls
Clarification is still an unsubmitted draft
The exact requested goal is visible before confirmation
Ready-to-confirm is not mistaken for permission to call
First full-plan quote is PKR 3,000
The over-budget warning is shown from the server result
An offer does not become an approved callback
Technical history is collapsed by default
Main dashboard contains user outcomes, not implementation commentary
Comparing does not silently switch the selected plan
Both complete plans are available for comparison
Selecting a plan does not call a helper back
Approval contains only the selected plan’s responder
Only Kindred Rescue receives an approval callback
Confirmation does not invent travel or arrival
Writing a closure note does not close the rescue before confirmation
The complete start-to-finish rescue is saved
The reporter’s closing note is visible on the finished rescue
Sound stays off until explicitly enabled

cues.title: MEET RESCUE RELAY
cues.text: From finding an animal in need to bringing the right help together. Fictional example shown.

cues.title: TRY A COMPLETE RESCUE
cues.text: Load the example, then make the same decisions you would in your own rescue.

cues.title: DESCRIBE WHAT YOU SEE
cues.text: A dog cannot put weight on its rear leg. The location and a PKR 2,000 budget are ready to review.

cues.title: CLARIFY THE OUTCOME
cues.text: Review the report. Describe what a successful rescue should include.

cues.title: YOUR GOAL, YOUR CHOICE
cues.text: Check the goal and location. Edit anything that is not right before finding help.

cues.title: FIND AVAILABLE HELP
cues.text: Confirm the goal to check your trusted contacts for availability and prices.

cues.title: REVIEW THE FIRST OPTION
cues.text: Greenway Rescue covers all three tasks. Its PKR 3,000 quote is above your budget.

cues.title: FIND ANOTHER OPTION
cues.text: Keep your first offer and ask for another option. Your selected plan stays unchanged.

cues.title: COMPARE COMPLETE PLANS
cues.text: Kindred Rescue offers the same requested tasks for PKR 1,500, within your budget.

cues.title: CHOOSE YOUR PLAN
cues.text: Choose the plan that works for you. You stay in control of the final approval.

cues.title: REVIEW BEFORE APPROVAL
cues.text: Confirm the selected helper, included tasks and price limit.

cues.title: CONFIRM YOUR HELPER
cues.text: Approve the plan. The chosen helper is asked to confirm the agreed work and price.

cues.title: HELP IS CONFIRMED
cues.text: The helper is ready. Keep the rescue up to date as you hear from them.

cues.title: ON THE WAY
cues.text: When the helper confirms departure, record “On the way”.

cues.title: ARRIVAL CONFIRMED
cues.text: Record arrival after it has been confirmed by you or the helper.

cues.title: THEIR PART IS FINISHED
cues.text: Mark the helper’s work as finished once their part of the rescue is complete.

cues.title: CLOSE THE LOOP
cues.text: Add where the animal is now, and confirm that it is safe.

cues.title: A SAFE PLACE. A FINISHED RESCUE.
cues.text: The closing note, helper updates and conversations remain with your report.

source: Unmodified live-app HTML, CSS and JS with the actual isolated mock API
